subject: SOC 2 Type II — targeted control handoff, bridge letter & audit window
messages:
From: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@averis.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II request + targeted control artifacts / bridge letter

Hi Olga,

Thanks again — Averis is kicking off a security review as part of our vendor approval for Q2. We have the SOC 2 Type II report on file but need a couple of follow-ups to close our audit:

- Signed bridge letter that covers the period between Redwood's last SOC 2 report and our contract go-live (we're targeting a May 1 start).
- Scoped control artifacts tied to authentication and access controls: MFA enforcement history (rotations, exceptions), recent privileged account deprovisioning records, and an auth-log sample for the audit window.

Target audit window: 2026-11-01 through 2027-01-31 (please confirm you can provide slices from that period).

Can you confirm: who at Redwood will own the artifacts delivery, preferred transfer method (SFTP/secure Drive), and whether a DocuSign-ready bridge letter is something you can produce?

We're hoping to complete procurement by 2027-03-05, so any ETA on evidence would be helpful.

Thanks,
Emma Clarke
Vendor Risk Lead | Averis Therapeutics
emma.clarke@averis.com
[Attachment: averis_evidence_request_v1.pdf (PDF)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@averis.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II request + targeted control artifacts / bridge letter

Emma — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. High level: we can provide a signed bridge letter and scoped artifacts for the audit window you listed, with a few clarifying questions below so we can scope extracts appropriately.

1) Bridge letter: Redwood Legal will prepare a DocuSign-ready draft. Are you OK receiving a draft to review, or do you need a pre-signed PDF?
2) MFA artifacts: do you need a full rotation history (changes to enrolled factors) or slices showing enforcement status and exception events?
3) Auth logs: we can provide JSON/CSV slices with redacted PII. Please confirm the minimum fields you require (timestamp, username/email, event_type, source_ip, outcome).
4) Privileged deprovisioning: we can produce an activity list for accounts removed from privileged groups and any associated change tickets. Is ticket id linkage required?

Delivery options: secure SFTP or Drive share with access logging. We will prepare an evidence manifest to enumerate files and formats.

I've attached a preliminary manifest (evidence_manifest_v1.xlsx) — it lists what we anticipate being able to provide and where we'll need a bit of coordination.

Proposed internal owners: me (coord), Karthik for log extracts, Laura for control attestation. Proposed delivery target: by 2027-02-26 if that's workable for your procurement timeline.

-Olga
Olga Petrov
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: evidence_manifest_v1.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 11:25:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II request + targeted control artifacts / bridge letter

Thanks — quick technical clarifications from infra side:

- Auth-log slices: we can export up to the full set for the window (2026-11-01 -> 2027-01-31) but will need to redact any request bodies and PII. We'll provide CSV with fields: timestamp, user_email, event_type, service, source_ip, outcome, request_id. If Averis needs additional columns (e.g., user_agent), state that now.
- MFA history: we do not keep factor rotations per se in a single table; we can provide an enrollment/change log and enforcement policy change events. I've attached a sample mapping (mfa_rotation_matrix.csv) showing the shape.
- Privileged deprovisioning: we can provide a list of accounts removed from privileged groups and link to internal change tickets where available. For tickets created in Jira, we'll provide the ticket key but cannot export full Jira records without a separate request.

Notes: retention windows vary by log type. For the requested window we have full coverage for auth events and deprovisioning records. Some enriched fields (e.g., geolocation) are derived and may be approximate.

I will prepare the auth-log sample (redacted) and a CSV manifest for upload. Suggested upload location: pre-provisioned SFTP path (we'll generate credentials), or we can post to the Drive folder you shared — SFTP preferred for audit artifacts.

-Karthik
Engineer, Platform Security
[Attachment: mfa_rotation_matrix.csv (CSV)]

From: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@averis.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: John Lee - Audit Manager <audit@averis-audit.com>, Averis Procurement <procurement@averis.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 08:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II request + targeted control artifacts / bridge letter

Thanks Olga/Karthik — that all sounds good. A few quick replies inline:

- Bridge letter: DocuSign draft is perfect; we'll countersign. Please send the draft to procurement@averis.com and audit@averis-audit.com when ready.
- Auth-log fields: the set you proposed (timestamp, user_email, event_type, service, source_ip, outcome, request_id) is sufficient. If user_agent is not available, that's OK.
- Privileged deprovisioning: ticket keys are fine; we'll operate under the assumption we can reference them.

Audit team confirms the audit window (2026-11-01 to 2027-01-31). Procurement notes that evidence needs to be available to our review team no later than 2027-02-26 to keep the 2027-03-05 approval.

One ask: can you provide a single auth-log sample file (~500 rows) within 48 hours for our technical team to sanity-check formats? Also, we'll need a secure link for the full upload; SFTP works.

Thanks — I'll loop John if they need any follow-up technical clarifications.

Best,
Emma
[Attachment: averis_requirements_schema.pdf (PDF)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@averis.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II request + targeted control artifacts / bridge letter

Emma — appreciate the quick turnaround. Action plan below and owners:

- By 2027-02-24 EOD: upload single auth-log sample (~500 rows, redacted) to pre-provisioned SFTP. Owner: Karthik Iyer. [Attachment: auth_log_sample_snippet.json (JSON)]
- By 2027-02-26 EOD: full artifact bundle (MFA enrollment/change log, privileged deprovisioning list with ticket keys, signed DocuSign bridge letter) uploaded to SFTP folder: sftp.redwood.ai/averis/2027-02-26. Owner: Olga Petrov.
- Legal: Draft bridge letter will be sent to procurement@averis.com via DocuSign by 2027-02-23. Owner: Laura Bennett (Legal).
- Notes on formats: CSV/JSON for logs; XLSX for manifest; PDFs for signed statements.

Please confirm the SFTP user you'd like us to provision or, if you prefer Drive, confirm the exact shared folder. Once you confirm, we'll create credentials and share the connection details over the compliance portal.

Thanks — we'll keep communication in this thread for audit traceability.

-Olga
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
